title: pvSmooth
body:
## pvSmooth

Laplacian smoothing of a polygonal surface: each point moves iteratively toward the average of its connected neighbours, for up to NumberofIterations (ParaView default 20) or until the largest motion falls below Convergence. VTK's relaxation factor of 0.01 keeps each step small. Connectivity, point count and arrays are unchanged. Use it to reduce noise or faceting of scanned or iso-surfaces; smooth is the curated version.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Laplacian smoothing shrinks the surface and rounds edges; use few iterations when dimensions matter.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Smooth`. Identity: `filters/SmoothPolyDataFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Smooth filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Convergence` | The value of this property limits the maximum motion of any point. It is expressed as a fraction of the length of the diagonal of the bounding box of the input dataset. If the maximum point motion during a smoothing iteration is less than the value of this property, the smoothing operation terminates. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `NumberofIterations` | This property sets the maximum number of smoothing iterations to perform. More iterations produce better smoothing. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSmooth",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
